episodes.title: EMMA
episodes.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang are to find evidence of falsified financial reports at Vicky Games. Cheng Xiaoshi is able to get inside the company through a photo of assistant Emma, but the plan turns out to be more difficult than expected.

episodes.title: Secret Recipe
episodes.summary: Restaurant owner Yu Xia needs the help of Lu Guang and Cheng Xiaoshi because her former business partner Lin Zhen is keeping the secret soup recipe from her.

episodes.title: To Lose, Not To Win
episodes.summary: Architect Chen Xiao wants to make up for some events in his youth. Although our hero Cheng Xiaoshi is supposed to just deliver some messages, he suddenly finds himself in a complicated situation where he has to restore friendships with his old basketball buddies.

episodes.title: Confess
episodes.summary: After the basketball game the mission is far from over. It is only during the course of the mission that Lu Guang and Cheng Xiaoshi realize the chaos that client Chen Xiao has left behind. Will the team manage to win back the heart of Chen Xiao's great childhood sweetheart?

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.summary: In the last part of Chen Xiao's mission the situation becomes so messed up that there is a shift in space and time. Suddenly, the lives of many people are at stake.

episodes.title: Search of The Child
episodes.summary: The police need Lu Guang and Cheng Xiaoshi's help in finding a missing child. But how can they help when there is no photo at hand?

episodes.title: Aunt May
episodes.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi manages to gain access to the time of little Doudou's disappearance. While at first it seems that he can save the boy, the kidnapper poses a tought challenge to him.

episodes.title: Lost Signal
episodes.summary: Out of heartache, Qiao Ling's friend Xu Shanshan turns to the three of them to win back the love of her life. An assignment that is supposed to be simple gets out of hand when Cheng Xiaoshi is suddenly drawn into a criminal case.

episodes.title: Consequence of Goodwill
episodes.summary: Xu Shanshan still hasn't shown up and the search for her continues. A seemingly clear suspicion turns out to be wrong. Or does it?

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang continue to search for Xu Shanshan and are suddenly confronted with a serial killer. For their safety, they must make a dangerous pact with the killer.

episodes.title: Pinnacle of Light
episodes.summary: Finally, the serial killer is caught. But the case is far from over and suddenly events come to a head.

episodes.title: Can't Live Without a Good Brother
So Time Begins to Flow Again
episodes.summary: Lu Guang goes back in time to where it all began.

episodes.title: Prelude
episodes.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi finds a photograph of the city of Bridon, apparently sent by his father. At the same time, a series of scams taking place in the same locality are making headlines in the news. Knowing him, he will not hesitate to go to Lu Guang to uncover the mystery.

episodes.title: Them
episodes.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon in search of clues to solve the mystery of Cheng Xiaoshi's father. When they reach the airport, problems immediately arise for them…

episodes.title: And then there were none
episodes.summary: The mysterious boss of Xia Fei comes to the boys' rescue, but after the first exchange of words, Lu Guang notices that something isn't right.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi understands his power thanks to Lu Guang, and they try to find out who survived the disaster.

episodes.title: Puzzle
episodes.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi finally manages to talk to Vein, but to help him, Vein demands that he and Lu Guang help him replace a fired model.
